input: How much does the Pro plan cost?
expected_output: The Pro plan costs 8 USD per user per month.
context: The Pro plan costs 8 USD per user per month and includes unlimited notebooks and 50 GB of storage.

input: Is there a minimum number of users on the Team plan?
expected_output: Yes, the Team plan requires a minimum of 3 users.
context: The Team plan costs 14 USD per user per month, includes 1 TB of shared storage, and requires a minimum of 3 users.

input: How long do I have to get a refund on an annual subscription?
expected_output: Annual subscriptions can be refunded within 30 days of purchase.
context: Annual subscriptions can be refunded within 30 days of purchase.

input: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
expected_output: No. Two-factor authentication supports authenticator apps and hardware security keys; SMS codes are not supported.
context: Two-factor authentication supports authenticator apps and hardware security keys. SMS codes are not supported.

input: I deleted my account by mistake. Can I get it back?
expected_output: Yes, within 30 days of deletion the account can be restored by contacting support. After 30 days the data is permanently deleted.
context: Deleting an account moves its data to a 30 day recovery window. During those 30 days the account can be restored by contacting support.

input: If I downgrade from Pro to Free with 10 notebooks, what happens to them and when?
expected_output: The downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period. The Free plan includes 3 notebooks, so the other notebooks become read-only; nothing is deleted.
context: The Free plan costs nothing and includes 3 notebooks and 500 MB of storage.
Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period. Downgrading to Free when you have more than 3 notebooks makes the extra notebooks read-only; nothing is deleted.

input: We are on the Team plan and uptime last month was 98.7 percent. What do we get?
expected_output: Uptime fell below 99.0 percent, so Team customers receive a 25 percent service credit for that month.
context: If uptime falls below that, Team customers receive a 10 percent service credit for that month, and a 25 percent credit if it falls below 99.0 percent.

input: Does the Nimbus Notes Android app work offline?
expected_output: The documentation does not cover this, so the assistant should say it does not know rather than guess.

input: Who is the CEO of Nimbus Notes?
expected_output: The documentation does not cover this, so the assistant should say it does not know.

input: How do I switch my SMS two-factor codes to a different phone number?
expected_output: The assistant should point out that SMS codes are not supported and that two-factor authentication uses authenticator apps or hardware security keys.
context: Two-factor authentication supports authenticator apps and hardware security keys. SMS codes are not supported.

input: What are the steps to move my existing workspace from Frankfurt to the US region?
expected_output: The assistant should say that moving an existing workspace between regions is not supported; the region is chosen when the workspace is created.
context: Team plan customers can choose the US (Virginia) region when creating the workspace. Moving an existing workspace between regions is not supported.

input: Can I collect my refund in cash at the office?
expected_output: No. Refunds go back to the original payment method; Nimbus Notes does not refund in cash or store credit.
context: Refunds go back to the original payment method and take 5 to 10 business days to appear. Nimbus Notes does not refund in cash or store credit.
